verdict.rationale: Together documents a catalog of 100+ open-source models and a model lifecycle policy that includes 'a structured approach to introducing new models.' A dedicated-endpoint example deploys a Gemma 4 model, which suggests it onboards current open-weight releases. Nothing in the evidence states how quickly new releases appear after public launch. missing for 10: any documented or observed time-to-availability for new open-weight releases, a new-model announcement or changelog cadence, independent or hands-on corroboration of fast onboarding.
